notes.title: Absence of Light Action RPG
notes.content: Absence of Light is an indie action RPG focused on combat. The game is inspired by horror games like Resident Evil and medieval games such as Soulslike games and Nier Automata. The current demo represents only a small portion of the entire game experience. The full game will feature 5 main bosses, while this demo includes 1 main boss and 2 sub-bosses
